unverified.suspicion: In the MaxDestChars overload of Utf8ToWideChar(), the loop stops when dest reaches endDest = @dest0[MaxDestChars], then quit/nosource does dest^ := #0 at that address, i.e. one WideChar past MaxDestChars. mormot.db.rad.ui.pas:374 calls it with Field.DataSize shr 1 for a dest buffer of DataSize bytes, so a field that fills the buffer would take a 2-byte write past its end.
unverified.why_unproven: Not introduced by this commit: it only rewrites the endDest computation (inc(MaxDestChars,MaxDestChars); inc(MaxDestChars,PtrUInt(dest))) into the equivalent MaxDestChars := PtrUInt(@dest[MaxDestChars]). The doubled bound came from aa8eec32 (PR #552), so the behaviour belongs to that commit; reported here only so a human can look, not as a finding against this sha.
